questions.questionTextEn: Consider an ideal gas of $N$ non-interacting localized particles of spin $S = 1$ placed in an external uniform magnetic field $B$ along the $z$-axis. Each particle has a magnetic dipole moment $\mathbf{\mu} = g \mu_B \mathbf{S}$. The single-particle Hamiltonian is $H_1 = -\mu_z B = -m_S \mu B$, where $m_S \in \{-1, 0, +1\}$. The single-particle partition function $Z_1$ at absolute temperature $T$ (with $\beta = 1/k_B T$) is:
questions.explanationEn:
The allowed values of magnetic quantum number $m_S$ for spin 1 are $-1, 0, +1$.
The corresponding energy eigenvalues are:
- For $m_S = +1$: $E = -\mu B$
- For $m_S = 0$: $E = 0$
- For $m_S = -1$: $E = +\mu B$
The single-particle partition function is the sum over these three microstates:
$$Z_1 = \sum_{m_S = -1}^1 e^{-\beta E} = e^{\beta \mu B} + e^0 + e^{-\beta \mu B} = 1 + (e^{\beta \mu B} + e^{-\beta \mu B}) = 1 + 2\cosh(\beta \mu B)$$
Option (A) is correct.
questions.questionTextHi: बाह्य एकसमान चुंबकीय क्षेत्र $B$ में रखे चक्रण $S = 1$ के $N$ गैर-अन्योन्यक्रियाकारी कणों की एक आदर्श गैस पर विचार कीजिए। एकल-कण हैमिल्टोनियन $H_1 = -m_S \mu B$ है ($m_S = -1, 0, +1$)। तापमान $T$ पर एकल-कण संवितरण फलन (partition function) $Z_1$ क्या है?
questions.explanationHi: ऊर्जा स्तर $E = -\mu B, 0, +\mu B$ हैं। संवितरण फलन $Z_1 = e^{\beta \mu B} + 1 + e^{-\beta \mu B} = 1 + 2\cosh(\beta \mu B)$ प्राप्त होता है (विकल्प A)।

questions.questionTextEn: A quantity of water at initial temperature $T_1 = 300\text{ K}$ is brought to final temperature $T_2 = 320\text{ K}$ at atmospheric pressure. The process is carried out either reversibly using an infinite series of heat reservoirs or irreversibly by placing the water directly in contact with a single thermal reservoir at $320\text{ K}$. Which of the following statements about the entropy change of the universe (system + surroundings) $\Delta S_{univ}$ is CORRECT?
optionsEn: \Delta S_{univ} = 0 for the reversible process, and \Delta S_{univ} > 0 for the irreversible process
\Delta S_{univ} > 0 for both the reversible and irreversible processes
questions.explanationEn:
By the Second Law of Thermodynamics:
- For any reversible process between initial and final states, the entropy generated is zero: $\Delta S_{univ} = \Delta S_{sys} + \Delta S_{surr} = 0$.
- For any irreversible process, spontaneous entropy production occurs due to finite temperature gradient heat transfer: $\Delta S_{univ} = \Delta S_{sys} + \Delta S_{surr} > 0$.
Therefore, $\Delta S_{univ} = 0$ for the reversible process and $\Delta S_{univ} > 0$ for the irreversible process. Option (B) is correct.
questions.questionTextHi: जल को $300\text{ K}$ से $320\text{ K}$ तक उत्क्रमणीय अथवा अनुत्क्रमणीय रूप से गर्म किया जाता है। ब्रह्मांड के एंट्रॉपी परिवर्तन $\Delta S_{univ}$ के संबंध में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
optionsHi: उत्क्रमणीय प्रक्रम के लिए $\Delta S_{univ} = 0$, तथा अनुत्क्रमणीय प्रक्रम के लिए $\Delta S_{univ} > 0$
questions.explanationHi: ऊष्मागतिकी के द्वितीय नियम से उत्क्रमणीय प्रक्रम में ब्रह्मांड की एंट्रॉपी संरक्षित रहती है ($\Delta S_{univ} = 0$), जबकि अनुत्क्रमणीय प्रक्रम में एंट्रॉपी बढ़ती है ($\Delta S_{univ} > 0$)। अतः विकल्प (B) सही है।

questions.questionTextEn: A student sets up Young’s double slit experiment with electrons of momentum $p$. The slits are separated by distance $d$ and the detector screen is at distance $D$. If the momentum of the electrons is doubled ($p' = 2p$), how does the interference fringe width $\beta$ change?
questions.explanationEn:
The de Broglie wavelength of an electron with momentum $p$ is $\lambda = \frac{h}{p}$.
The fringe width on the detection screen in a Young's double-slit experiment is:
$$\beta = \frac{\lambda D}{d} = \frac{h D}{p d}$$
When the momentum is doubled ($p' = 2p$):
$$\beta' = \frac{h D}{(2p) d} = \frac{1}{2} \left(\frac{h D}{p d}\right) = \frac{\beta}{2}$$
Therefore, the fringe width is halved. Option (B) is correct.
questions.questionTextHi: संवेग $p$ के इलेक्ट्रॉनों के साथ यंग द्वि-स्लिट प्रयोग किया जाता है। यदि इलेक्ट्रॉनों का संवेग दोगुना ($p' = 2p$) कर दिया जाए, तो व्यतिकरण फ्रिंज चौड़ाई $\beta$ में क्या परिवर्तन होगा?
optionsHi: फ्रिंज चौड़ाई चार गुनी हो जाएगी
questions.explanationHi: डी-ब्रोग्ली तरंगदैर्घ्य $\lambda = h/p$ होती है। फ्रिंज चौड़ाई $\beta = \frac{\lambda D}{d} = \frac{h D}{pd}$। संवेग दोगुना करने पर फ्रिंज चौड़ाई आधी ($\beta/2$) हो जाती है (विकल्प B)।

questions.questionTextEn: Consider a particle in three different one-dimensional potential wells of equal width $L$. Box 1 is an infinite square well ($V=0$ inside, $V=\infty$ outside). Box 2 has finite depth $V_0$. Box 3 has a step potential inside. Comparing the ground state energy $E_1^{(1)}$ of Box 1 with $E_1^{(2)}$ of Box 2, which of the following is CORRECT?
optionsEn: E_1^{(2)} < E_1^{(1)} because the wavefunction penetrates into the classically forbidden region, increasing the effective width of the box
questions.explanationEn:
In an infinite potential well of width $L$, the wavefunction must strictly vanish at the boundaries ($x = 0$ and $x = L$).
In a finite potential well of depth $V_0$ and width $L$, the wavefunction decays exponentially into the barrier regions ($x < 0$ and $x > L$) with finite penetration depth $\delta = 1/\kappa$.
This penetration effectively increases the de Broglie wavelength of the particle (effective box width $L_{eff} \approx L + 2\delta > L$).
Since the energy eigenvalues scale inversely with the square of the effective wavelength/width ($E \propto 1/L_{eff}^2$), the ground state energy in the finite well is strictly lower than in the infinite well:
$$E_1^{(2)} < E_1^{(1)}$$
Option (A) is correct.
questions.questionTextHi: समान चौड़ाई $L$ के तीन विभिन्न विभव कूपों में एक कण पर विचार कीजिए। कूप 1 अनंत गहराई का है, जबकि कूप 2 परिमित गहराई $V_0$ का है। कूप 2 की मूल अवस्था ऊर्जा $E_1^{(2)}$ की तुलना कूप 1 से करने पर कौन-सा कथन सही है?
optionsHi: E_1^{(2)} < E_1^{(1)} क्योंकि तरंगफलन वर्जित क्षेत्र में प्रवेश करता है जिससे प्रभावी चौड़ाई बढ़ जाती है
questions.explanationHi: परिमित कूप में तरंगफलन रोधिका में प्रवेश करता है, जिससे प्रभावी चौड़ाई बढ़ जाती है और ऊर्जा कम हो जाती है ($E_1^{(2)} < E_1^{(1)}$)। अतः विकल्प (A) सही है।

questions.questionTextEn: In cylindrical polar coordinates $(s, \phi, z)$, a charged particle moves in an axisymmetric magnetic field described by vector potential $\mathbf{A} = \frac{B_0 s}{2} \hat{\phi}$. Which of the following quantities is a constant of motion (conserved quantity)?
optionsEn: Canonical angular momentum p_\phi = m s^2 \dot{\phi} + \frac{q B_0 s^2}{2}
questions.explanationEn:
The Lagrangian of a charged particle in an electromagnetic field is:
$$L = \frac{1}{2}m (\dot{s}^2 + s^2 \dot{\phi}^2 + \dot{z}^2) + q \mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{v} - q \Phi$$
With $\mathbf{A} = A_\phi(s) \hat{\phi} = \frac{B_0 s}{2} \hat{\phi}$:
$$\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{v} = A_\phi (s \dot{\phi}) = \frac{B_0 s^2}{2} \dot{\phi}$$
Notice that the Lagrangian does not depend on the azimuthal angle $\phi$ ($\frac{\partial L}{\partial \phi} = 0$), so $\phi$ is a cyclic coordinate.
The generalized momentum conjugate to $\phi$ is conserved:
$$p_\phi = \frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{\phi}} = m s^2 \dot{\phi} + q s A_\phi = m s^2 \dot{\phi} + \frac{q B_0 s^2}{2} = \text{constant}$$
Option (C) is correct.
questions.questionTextHi: बेलनाकार निर्देशांकों $(s, \phi, z)$ में सदिश विभव $\mathbf{A} = \frac{B_0 s}{2} \hat{\phi}$ द्वारा वर्णित चुंबकीय क्षेत्र में एक आवेशित कण गति करता है। कौन-सी राशि गति का अचर (संरक्षित राशि) है?
optionsHi: विहित कोणीय संवेग p_\phi = m s^2 \dot{\phi} + \frac{q B_0 s^2}{2}
questions.explanationHi: लाग्रेंजियन में निर्देशांक $\phi$ अनुपस्थित है (चक्रीय निर्देशांक), अतः इसके संयुग्मी विहित संवेग $p_\phi = m s^2 \dot{\phi} + \frac{q B_0 s^2}{2}$ का मान समय के साथ संरक्षित रहता है (विकल्प C)।

questions.questionTextEn: A particle of mass $m = 1\text{ kg}$ is released from rest from a height $h = 1\text{ m}$ above the top of a vertical massless spring of force constant $k = 100\text{ N/m}$. Taking $g = 10\text{ m/s}^2$, what is the maximum compression $x$ of the spring?
questions.explanationEn:
Let the maximum compression of the spring be $x$.
During the fall, the particle loses gravitational potential energy from its initial release point to the lowest point of maximum compression (total descent $= h + x$):
$$\Delta U_{grav} = m g (h + x)$$
At maximum compression, the particle comes instantaneously to rest (kinetic energy $K = 0$).
By conservation of mechanical energy:
$$m g (h + x) = \frac{1}{2} k x^2$$
Substituting $m = 1\text{ kg}, g = 10\text{ m/s}^2, h = 1\text{ m}, k = 100\text{ N/m}$:
$$10(1 + x) = \frac{1}{2} (100) x^2 = 50 x^2$$
$$50 x^2 - 10 x - 10 = 0 \implies 5 x^2 - x - 1 = 0$$
Solving the quadratic equation using the quadratic formula:
$$x = \frac{-(-1) + \sqrt{(-1)^2 - 4(5)(-1)}}{2(5)} = \frac{1 + \sqrt{1 + 20}}{10} = \frac{1 + \sqrt{21}}{10} \approx \frac{1 + 4.5826}{10} = 0.558\text{ m} \approx 0.57\text{ m}$$
Option (D) is correct.
questions.questionTextHi: द्रव्यमान $m = 1\text{ kg}$ का एक कण स्प्रिंग नियतांक $k = 100\text{ N/m}$ वाली एक ऊर्ध्वाधर स्प्रिंग के शीर्ष से $h = 1\text{ m}$ की ऊंचाई से विराम से छोड़ा जाता है ($g = 10\text{ m/s}^2$)। स्प्रिंग का अधिकतम संपीडन $x$ क्या है?
questions.explanationHi:
ऊर्जा संरक्षण से $mg(h + x) = \frac{1}{2}kx^2 \implies 5x^2 - x - 1 = 0$।
हल करने पर $x = \frac{1 + \sqrt{21}}{10} \approx 0.56\text{ m} \approx 0.57\text{ m}$ प्राप्त होता है (विकल्प D)।

questions.questionTextEn: For a two-dimensional isotropic harmonic oscillator with potential $V(x, y) = \frac{1}{2}m\omega^2(x^2 + y^2)$, which one of the following combinations of dynamical variables is a constant of motion?
questions.explanationEn:
In a 2D isotropic harmonic oscillator, the potential $V(x, y) = \frac{1}{2}m\omega^2 r^2$ is spherically symmetric (central force potential dependent only on $r = \sqrt{x^2 + y^2}$).
By Noether's theorem, rotational invariance about the $z$-axis implies the conservation of the $z$-component of angular momentum:
$$L_z = (\mathbf{r} \times \mathbf{p})_z = m (x \dot{y} - y \dot{x})$$
Dividing by the constant mass $m$, the quantity $x \dot{y} - y \dot{x}$ is identically a conserved constant of motion. Option (A) is correct.
questions.questionTextHi: विभव $V(x, y) = \frac{1}{2}m\omega^2(x^2 + y^2)$ वाले एक द्विविमीय समदैशिक आवर्ती दोलक के लिए कौन-सा चर गति का अचर है?
questions.explanationHi: केंद्रीय विभव में घूर्णन सममिति के कारण कोणीय संवेग $L_z = m(x\dot{y} - y\dot{x})$ संरक्षित रहता है। अतः $x\dot{y} - y\dot{x}$ गति का अचर है (विकल्प A)।

questions.questionTextEn: In a two-dimensional square lattice of lattice constant $a$, the dispersion relation for acoustic phonons in the long wavelength limit ($k a \ll 1$) is linear: $\omega(\mathbf{k}) = v_s |\mathbf{k}|$, where $v_s$ is the sound velocity. The density of phonon states $D(\omega)$ in this two-dimensional system scales with $\omega$ as:
questions.explanationEn:
In $d$-dimensional space with linear dispersion $\omega = v_s k$:
- The number of $k$-space states within a radius $k$ in 2D is $N(k) = \frac{\text{Area}}{(2\pi)^2} \pi k^2 = \frac{A}{4\pi} k^2$.
- Since $k = \frac{\omega}{v_s}$, we have $N(\omega) = \frac{A}{4\pi v_s^2} \omega^2$.
- The density of states $D(\omega)$ is the derivative of $N(\omega)$ with respect to $\omega$:
  $$D(\omega) = \frac{dN}{d\omega} = \frac{A}{2\pi v_s^2} \omega \propto \omega^1$$
In 2D, the phonon density of states is directly proportional to $\omega$ (unlike in 3D where $D(\omega) \propto \omega^2$). Option (A) is correct.
questions.questionTextHi: द्विविमीय वर्गाकार जालक में दीर्घ तरंगदैर्घ्य सीमा में ध्वनिक फोनों के लिए विक्षेपण संबंध $\omega = v_s k$ है। इस द्विविमीय निकाय में फोनों अवस्था घनत्व $D(\omega)$ किस प्रकार निर्भर करता है?
questions.explanationHi: द्विविम में $k$-आकाश का क्षेत्रफल $\pi k^2 \propto \omega^2$ होता है। अतः अवस्था घनत्व $D(\omega) = \frac{dN}{d\omega} \propto \omega$ होता है (विकल्प A)।

questions.questionTextEn: At absolute zero temperature ($T = 0\text{ K}$), which of the following diagrams correctly represents the Fermi-Dirac distribution function $f(E)$ as a function of energy $E$ for electrons?
optionsEn: A step function with f(E) = 1 for E < E_F, and f(E) = 0 for E > E_F
A linearly decreasing line from 1 to 0
questions.explanationEn:
The Fermi-Dirac distribution function is:
$$f(E) = \frac{1}{e^{(E - E_F)/k_B T} + 1}$$
In the limit as $T \to 0\text{ K}$:
- For $E < E_F$: $\frac{E - E_F}{k_B T} \to -\infty \implies e^{-\infty} = 0 \implies f(E) = \frac{1}{0 + 1} = 1$.
- For $E > E_F$: $\frac{E - E_F}{k_B T} \to +\infty \implies e^{+\infty} = \infty \implies f(E) = \frac{1}{\infty + 1} = 0$.
At $T = 0\text{ K}$, all states below the Fermi level $E_F$ are completely filled ($f = 1$) and all states above $E_F$ are completely empty ($f = 0$). This forms an abrupt Heaviside step function. Option (A) is correct.
questions.questionTextHi: परम शून्य तापमान ($T = 0\text{ K}$) पर इलेक्ट्रॉनों के लिए फर्मी-डिराक वितरण फलन $f(E)$ का आरेख कैसा होता है?
optionsHi: एक सीढ़ीदार फलन (step function) जिसमें E < E_F के लिए f(E) = 1 तथा E > E_F के लिए f(E) = 0 हो
1 से 0 तक रैखिक रूप से घटती रेखा
questions.explanationHi: $T = 0\text{ K}$ पर $E < E_F$ के लिए सभी स्तर पूर्णतः भरे ($f=1$) तथा $E > E_F$ पर खाली ($f=0$) होते हैं। यह एक स्टेप फलन होता है (विकल्प A)।

questions.questionTextEn: For a one-dimensional quantum harmonic oscillator, the creation operator $a^\dagger$ acts on the energy eigenstate $|m\rangle$ as $a^\dagger |m\rangle = \sqrt{m + 1} |m + 1\rangle$. What is the matrix element $\langle n | a^\dagger | m \rangle$?
questions.explanationEn:
Applying the creation operator to state $|m\rangle$:
$$a^\dagger |m\rangle = \sqrt{m + 1} |m + 1\rangle$$
Taking the inner product with eigenstate $\langle n |$:
$$\langle n | a^\dagger | m \rangle = \sqrt{m + 1} \langle n | m + 1 \rangle$$
Due to the orthonormality of the harmonic oscillator eigenstates $\langle n | m + 1 \rangle = \delta_{n, m+1}$, we obtain:
$$\langle n | a^\dagger | m \rangle = \sqrt{m + 1} \delta_{n, m+1}$$
Option (C) is correct.
questions.questionTextHi: एक विमीय सरल आवर्ती दोलक के लिए निर्माण संकारक (creation operator) $a^\dagger$ का आव्यूह अवयव $\langle n | a^\dagger | m \rangle$ क्या है?
questions.explanationHi: $a^\dagger |m\rangle = \sqrt{m+1}|m+1\rangle$। अतः $\langle n | a^\dagger | m \rangle = \sqrt{m+1} \delta_{n, m+1}$ (विकल्प C)।

questions.questionTextEn: A piston of mass $m$ and cross-sectional area $A$ is fitted in an airtight horizontal cylindrical jar containing an ideal gas at pressure $P_0$ and volume $V_0$. When the piston is displaced slightly by a distance $x$ from its equilibrium position and released, it executes simple harmonic oscillations under adiabatic conditions. The angular frequency $\omega$ of small oscillations is:
questions.explanationEn:
Under reversible adiabatic conditions, the gas satisfies $P V^\gamma = \text{constant}$.
Differentiating with respect to volume $V$:
$$dP V^\gamma + \gamma P V^{\gamma - 1} dV = 0 \implies dP = -\gamma \frac{P}{V} dV$$
When the piston is displaced by $x$, the change in volume is $dV = A x$.
The restoring force on the piston is:
$$F = dP \cdot A = -\gamma \frac{P_0}{V_0} (A x) A = -\left( \frac{\gamma P_0 A^2}{V_0} \right) x$$
By Newton's second law, $F = m \ddot{x} = -k x$, where the effective spring constant is $k = \frac{\gamma P_0 A^2}{V_0}$.
The natural angular frequency of oscillation is:
$$\omega = \sqrt{\frac{k}{m}} = \sqrt{\frac{\gamma P_0 A^2}{m V_0}}$$
Option (B) is correct.
questions.questionTextHi: दाब $P_0$ तथा आयतन $V_0$ पर आदर्श गैस से भरे एक बेलनाकार पात्र में द्रव्यमान $m$ और अनुप्रस्थ काट $A$ का पिस्टन लगा है। रुद्धोष्म परिस्थितियों में पिस्टन के अल्प दोलनों की कोणीय आवृत्ति $\omega$ क्या है?
questions.explanationHi: रुद्धोष्म प्रत्यानयन बल $F = -\left(\frac{\gamma P_0 A^2}{V_0}\right) x$ होता है। अतः कोणीय आवृत्ति $\omega = \sqrt{\frac{\gamma P_0 A^2}{m V_0}}$ होती है (विकल्प B)।

questions.questionTextEn:
A paramagnetic salt of mass $m$ is initially held at temperature $T$ in a strong external magnetic field $H$. The salt is then thermally isolated and the magnetic field is adiabatically reduced to zero (adiabatic demagnetization). Which of the following statements is (are) CORRECT?
(A) The temperature of the salt increases
(B) The temperature of the salt decreases, producing cryogenic cooling
(C) During reversible adiabatic demagnetization, the magnetic entropy of the spin system is conserved
(D) The process is isothermal
optionsEn: The temperature of the salt increases
The temperature of the salt decreases, producing cryogenic cooling
During reversible adiabatic demagnetization, the magnetic entropy of the spin system is conserved
questions.explanationEn:
- In adiabatic demagnetization, the salt is thermally insulated ($dQ = 0$). For a reversible process, total entropy is conserved: $\Delta S = 0$ (Option C is CORRECT).
- The entropy of a paramagnetic spin system depends on the ratio $H/T$: $S = S(H/T)$.
  When the external magnetic field is reduced from $H_i$ to $H_f \ll H_i$ at constant entropy, the temperature must decrease proportionally to maintain $H/T \approx \text{constant}$:
  $$T_f = T_i \left(\frac{H_f}{H_i}\right) < T_i$$
  This provides cryogenic cooling to millikelvin temperatures (Option B is CORRECT, A and D are FALSE).
Therefore, Options (B) and (C) are correct.
questions.questionTextHi: एक अनुचुंबकीय लवण को तापमान $T$ और प्रबल चुंबकीय क्षेत्र $H$ में रखा गया है। इसे रुद्धोष्म रूप से विचुंबकित (adiabatic demagnetization) किया जाता है। कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
optionsHi: लवण का तापमान बढ़ जाता है
लवण का तापमान घट जाता है (शीतलन उत्पन्न होता है)
उत्क्रमणीय रुद्धोष्म विचुंबकन के दौरान एंट्रॉपी संरक्षित रहती है
questions.explanationHi: रुद्धोष्म विचुंबकन में $\Delta S = 0$ (एंट्रॉपी संरक्षित, C सत्य)। चुंबकीय क्षेत्र घटाने पर तापमान घटता है जिससे शीतलन होता है (B सत्य)। अतः सही विकल्प (B, C) हैं।

questions.questionTextEn:
A particle of mass $m$ moves without friction on the interior surface of a hollow spherical shell of radius $a$ under the action of downward gravity $-g \hat{z}$ (spherical pendulum). In spherical coordinates $(\theta, \phi)$:
(A) The angular momentum component $p_\phi = m a^2 \sin^2\theta \dot{\phi}$ is a conserved constant of motion
(B) The total mechanical energy $E = \frac{1}{2}m a^2 (\dot{\theta}^2 + \sin^2\theta \dot{\phi}^2) + m g a \cos\theta$ is conserved
(C) The angle $\theta$ is a cyclic coordinate
(D) The effective potential for the $\theta$ motion is $V_{eff}(\theta) = \frac{p_\phi^2}{2 m a^2 \sin^2\theta} + m g a \cos\theta$
optionsEn: The angular momentum component p_\phi = m a^2 sin^2\theta \dot{\phi} is a conserved constant of motion
The total mechanical energy E = (1/2) m a^2 (\dot{\theta}^2 + sin^2\theta \dot{\phi}^2) + m g a cos\theta is conserved
The angle \theta is a cyclic coordinate
The effective potential for the \theta motion is V_eff(\theta) = p_\phi^2 / (2 m a^2 sin^2\theta) + m g a cos\theta
questions.explanationEn:
- The Lagrangian of the spherical pendulum is:
  $$L = \frac{1}{2}m a^2 (\dot{\theta}^2 + \sin^2\theta \dot{\phi}^2) - m g a \cos\theta$$
- $\phi$ does not appear in $L$ ($\frac{\partial L}{\partial \phi} = 0$), so $\phi$ is cyclic and $p_\phi = m a^2 \sin^2\theta \dot{\phi}$ is conserved (Option A is CORRECT).
- $\theta$ appears in both $T$ and $V$, so $\theta$ is not cyclic (Option C is FALSE).
- The Lagrangian has no explicit time dependence, so total energy $E = T + V$ is conserved (Option B is CORRECT).
- Substituting $\dot{\phi} = \frac{p_\phi}{m a^2 \sin^2\theta}$ into the energy gives $E = \frac{1}{2}m a^2 \dot{\theta}^2 + V_{eff}(\theta)$, where $V_{eff}(\theta) = \frac{p_\phi^2}{2 m a^2 \sin^2\theta} + m g a \cos\theta$ (Option D is CORRECT).
Therefore, Options (A), (B), and (D) are correct.
questions.questionTextHi: त्रिज्या $a$ के खोखले गोलीय कोश के अंदर गुरुत्वाकर्षण के अधीन गतिमान कण के लिए कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
optionsHi: कोणीय संवेग p_\phi = m a^2 sin^2\theta \dot{\phi} संरक्षित अचर है
कुल यांत्रिक ऊर्जा E संरक्षित है
प्रभावी विभव V_eff(\theta) = p_\phi^2 / (2 m a^2 sin^2\theta) + m g a cos\theta है
questions.explanationHi: $\phi$ चक्रीय निर्देशांक है, अतः $p_\phi$ संरक्षित है (A सत्य)। ऊर्जा $E$ संरक्षित है (B सत्य)। $\theta$ चक्रीय नहीं है (C असत्य)। प्रभावी विभव $V_{eff}(\theta)$ सही है (D सत्य)। अतः सही विकल्प (A, B, D) हैं।

questions.questionTextEn:
A particle of unit mass ($m = 1$) moves in a central potential $V(r) = -V_0 e^{-r^2}$, where $V_0 > 0$. With non-zero angular momentum $L$:
(A) The effective potential is $V_{eff}(r) = \frac{L^2}{2 r^2} - V_0 e^{-r^2}$
(B) For small $r$, the repulsive centrifugal barrier $\frac{L^2}{2r^2}$ dominates
(C) Circular orbits are impossible at any energy
(D) The motion is always unbounded for all energies
optionsEn: The effective potential is V_eff(r) = L^2 / (2 r^2) - V_0 e^-r^2
For small r, the repulsive centrifugal barrier L^2 / (2 r^2) dominates
Circular orbits are impossible at any energy
The motion is always unbounded for all energies
questions.explanationEn:
- The effective potential in central force motion is $V_{eff}(r) = \frac{L^2}{2 m r^2} + V(r) = \frac{L^2}{2 r^2} - V_0 e^{-r^2}$ (Option A is CORRECT).
- As $r \to 0$, $V_0 e^{-r^2} \to V_0$ (finite), while $\frac{L^2}{2r^2} \to +\infty$. Thus the repulsive centrifugal term strictly dominates at small $r$ (Option B is CORRECT).
- For appropriate values of $L$ and $V_0$, $V_{eff}(r)$ can possess a local minimum, allowing stable circular orbits (Option C is FALSE).
- Bound states with negative total energy can exist in the potential well (Option D is FALSE).
Therefore, Options (A) and (B) are correct.
questions.questionTextHi: इकाई द्रव्यमान का एक कण केंद्रीय विभव $V(r) = -V_0 e^{-r^2}$ में गति करता है। कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
optionsHi: प्रभावी विभव V_eff(r) = L^2 / (2 r^2) - V_0 e^-r^2 है
अल्प r के लिए प्रतिकर्षी अपकेंद्री रोधिका L^2 / (2 r^2) प्रभावी होती है
किसी भी ऊर्जा पर वृत्ताकार कक्षाएं असंभव हैं
सभी ऊर्जाओं के लिए गति सदैव अबद्ध होती है
questions.explanationHi: प्रभावी विभव $V_{eff} = \frac{L^2}{2r^2} - V_0 e^{-r^2}$ (A सत्य)। $r \to 0$ पर $1/r^2$ पद प्रभावी होता है (B सत्य)। स्थानीय न्यूनतम पर वृत्तीय कक्षाएं संभव हैं। अतः सही विकल्प (A, B) हैं।

questions.questionTextEn:
In a diatomic molecule of reduced mass $\mu$, the characteristic energy scales for electronic, vibrational, and rotational transitions are denoted by $E_{elec}$, $E_{vib}$, and $E_{rot}$ respectively. Which of the following statements is (are) CORRECT?
(A) The energy scales satisfy the hierarchy $E_{elec} \gg E_{vib} \gg E_{rot}$
(B) $E_{rot} \gg E_{vib} \gg E_{elec}$
(C) This hierarchy of well-separated energy scales justifies the Born-Oppenheimer approximation
(D) Electronic and nuclear motions have identical time periods
optionsEn: The energy scales satisfy the hierarchy E_elec >> E_vib >> E_rot
This hierarchy of well-separated energy scales justifies the Born-Oppenheimer approximation
Electronic and nuclear motions have identical time periods
questions.explanationEn:
- In molecular physics, typical energy scales are:
  - $E_{elec} \sim 1\text{ to } 10\text{ eV}$ (electronic excitation)
  - $E_{vib} = \hbar \omega_{vib} \sim 0.1\text{ eV}$ (infrared vibrations)
  - $E_{rot} = \frac{\hbar^2}{2I} \sim 10^{-3}\text{ eV}$ (microwave rotations)
  Thus, $E_{elec} \gg E_{vib} \gg E_{rot}$ (Option A is CORRECT, B is FALSE).
- Because electrons move much faster than nuclei ($m_e / M \sim 10^{-4}$), electronic motion can be decoupled from nuclear motion. This is the cornerstone of the Born-Oppenheimer approximation (Option C is CORRECT, D is FALSE).
Therefore, Options (A) and (C) are correct.
questions.questionTextHi: एक द्विपरमाण्विक अणु में इलेक्ट्रॉनिक, कंपन, तथा घूर्णी संक्रमणों के विशिष्ट ऊर्जा पैमानों के संबंध में कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
optionsHi: ऊर्जा पैमाने पदानुक्रम E_elec >> E_vib >> E_rot को संतुष्ट करते हैं
यह सुस्पष्ट पदानुक्रम बॉर्न-ओपनहाइमर सन्निकटन को न्यायोचित ठहराता है
इलेक्ट्रॉनिक और नाभिकीय गतियों के आवर्तकाल समान होते हैं
questions.explanationHi: इलेक्ट्रॉनिक ऊर्जा ($\sim\text{eV}$) > कंपन ऊर्जा ($\sim 0.1\text{ eV}$) > घूर्णी ऊर्जा ($\sim 10^{-3}\text{ eV}$) होती है (A सत्य)। यह विशाल अंतर बॉर्न-ओपनहाइमर सन्निकटन का आधार है (C सत्य)। अतः सही विकल्प (A, C) हैं।

questions.questionTextEn:
The electronic specific heat of a normal metal at low temperature $T$ is given by $C_{el} = \gamma T$, where $\gamma$ is the Sommerfeld coefficient. Which of the following statements is (are) CORRECT?
(A) $\gamma$ is directly proportional to the density of electronic states at the Fermi energy $g(E_F)$
(B) $\gamma$ is inversely proportional to $g(E_F)$
(C) $\gamma$ increases with temperature
(D) For a 3D free electron gas, $\gamma = \frac{\pi^2 k_B^2}{3} g(E_F)$
optionsEn: γ is directly proportional to the density of electronic states at the Fermi energy g(E_F)
γ is inversely proportional to g(E_F)
For a 3D free electron gas, γ = (π^2 kB^2 / 3) g(E_F)
questions.explanationEn:
In Sommerfeld's free electron theory:
- The electronic heat capacity is derived from the thermal excitation of electrons within a shell of thickness $\sim k_B T$ around the Fermi surface:
  $$C_{el} = \frac{\pi^2}{3} k_B^2 g(E_F) T$$
- The Sommerfeld coefficient is $\gamma = \frac{\pi^2 k_B^2}{3} g(E_F)$ (Option D is CORRECT).
- Therefore, $\gamma \propto g(E_F)$ is directly proportional to the density of states at the Fermi level (Option A is CORRECT, B is FALSE).
- $\gamma$ is a temperature-independent material constant (Option C is FALSE).
Thus, Options (A) and (D) are correct.
questions.questionTextHi: निम्न ताप $T$ पर एक सामान्य धातु की इलेक्ट्रॉनिक विशिष्ट ऊष्मा $C_{el} = \gamma T$ है। कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
optionsHi: γ फर्मी ऊर्जा पर इलेक्ट्रॉनिक अवस्था घनत्व g(E_F) के सीधे समानुपाती है
γ तापमान के साथ बढ़ता है
3D मुक्त इलेक्ट्रॉन गैस के लिए γ = (π^2 kB^2 / 3) g(E_F)
questions.explanationHi: सोमरफील्ड सिद्धांत से $\gamma = \frac{\pi^2 k_B^2}{3} g(E_F)$ (D सत्य), अतः $\gamma \propto g(E_F)$ (A सत्य)। $\gamma$ तापमान से स्वतंत्र होता है। अतः सही विकल्प (A, D) हैं।

questions.questionTextEn:
In a Hall effect measurement on an intrinsic semiconductor with electron mobility $\mu_n$ and hole mobility $\mu_p$, the Hall voltage is measured. If the electron and hole concentrations are equal ($n = p = n_i$), the Hall coefficient $R_H$ is given by:
$$R_H = \frac{1}{e n_i} \frac{\mu_p^2 - \mu_n^2}{(\mu_p + \mu_n)^2}$$
Under what condition does the Hall voltage across the sample become exactly zero?
questions.explanationEn:
For an intrinsic semiconductor with both electrons and holes conducting:
$$R_H = \frac{1}{e} \frac{p \mu_p^2 - n \mu_n^2}{(p \mu_p + n \mu_n)^2}$$
Since $n = p = n_i$:
$$R_H = \frac{1}{e n_i} \frac{\mu_p^2 - \mu_n^2}{(\mu_p + \mu_n)^2}$$
The Hall electric field is $E_H = R_H J_x B_z$, and the Hall voltage is $V_H = E_H w$.
The Hall voltage becomes zero when $R_H = 0$:
$$\mu_p^2 - \mu_n^2 = 0 \implies (\mu_p - \mu_n)(\mu_p + \mu_n) = 0$$
Since mobilities are positive, $\mu_n = \mu_p$.
Therefore, the Hall voltage vanishes when electron mobility equals hole mobility (Option D).
questions.questionTextHi: नेज अर्धचालक (intrinsic semiconductor) में हॉल गुणांक $R_H = \frac{1}{e n_i} \frac{\mu_p^2 - \mu_n^2}{(\mu_p + \mu_n)^2}$ है। किस स्थिति में हॉल वोल्टेज ठीक शून्य हो जाएगा?
questions.explanationHi: हॉल वोल्टेज $V_H = 0$ तब होगा जब $R_H = 0$ हो। इसके लिए $\mu_p^2 - \mu_n^2 = 0 \implies \mu_n = \mu_p$ आवश्यक है (विकल्प D)।

questions.questionTextEn:
A parallel plate capacitor with plate area $A$ and separation $d$ is connected to a battery of constant voltage $V_0$. A dielectric slab of dielectric constant $\kappa > 1$ and thickness $d$ is inserted between the plates while the battery remains connected. Which of the following statements is (are) CORRECT?
(A) The capacitance increases to $C = \kappa C_0$
(B) The potential difference across the plates increases
(C) The electric charge on the plates increases to $Q = \kappa Q_0$
(D) The electrostatic energy stored in the capacitor increases to $U = \kappa U_0$
optionsEn: The capacitance increases to C = κ C0
The potential difference across the plates increases
The electric charge on the plates increases to Q = κ Q0
The electrostatic energy stored in the capacitor increases to U = κ U0
questions.explanationEn:
With the battery remaining connected across the capacitor:
- Potential difference is held constant by the battery: $V = V_0 = \text{const}$ (Option B is FALSE).
- The capacitance increases by dielectric constant $\kappa$: $C = \kappa C_0$ (Option A is CORRECT).
- The charge stored is $Q = C V_0 = (\kappa C_0) V_0 = \kappa Q_0$ (Option C is CORRECT).
- The stored electrostatic energy is $U = \frac{1}{2} C V_0^2 = \frac{1}{2} (\kappa C_0) V_0^2 = \kappa U_0$ (Option D is CORRECT).
Therefore, Options (A), (C), and (D) are correct.
questions.questionTextHi: वोल्टेज $V_0$ की बैटरी से जुड़े समांतर पट्ट संधारित्र में परावैद्युतांक $\kappa > 1$ की पट्टिका प्रविष्ट की जाती है। बैटरी जुड़े रहने पर कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
optionsHi: धारिता बढ़कर C = κ C0 हो जाती है
पट्टिकाओं के बीच विभवांतर बढ़ जाता है
पट्टिकाओं पर आवेश बढ़कर Q = κ Q0 हो जाता है
संग्रहीत स्थिरवैद्युत ऊर्जा बढ़कर U = κ U0 हो जाती है
questions.explanationHi: बैटरी जुड़ी होने से विभव $V_0$ स्थिर रहता है (B असत्य)। धारिता $C = \kappa C_0$ बढ़ती है (A सत्य)। आवेश $Q = \kappa Q_0$ बढ़ता है (C सत्य)। ऊर्जा $U = \frac{1}{2}CV_0^2 = \kappa U_0$ बढ़ती है (D सत्य)। अतः सही विकल्प (A, C, D) हैं।

questions.questionTextEn:
For a classical dynamical system with time-independent Hamiltonian $H(q, p)$, let $f(q, p)$ and $g(q, p)$ be two constants of motion. Which of the following statements is (are) CORRECT?
(A) The Poisson bracket $\{f, H\} = 0$
(B) The Poisson bracket $\{g, H\} = 0$
(C) Poisson brackets are commutative: $\{f, g\} = \{g, f\}$
(D) According to Poisson's theorem, the Poisson bracket $\{f, g\}$ is also a constant of motion
optionsEn: Poisson brackets are commutative: {f, g} = {g, f}
According to Poisson's theorem, the Poisson bracket {f, g} is also a constant of motion
questions.explanationEn:
- The equation of motion for any observable $f$ is $\frac{df}{dt} = \{f, H\} + \frac{\partial f}{\partial t}$. Since $f$ and $g$ are constants of motion without explicit time dependence, $\frac{df}{dt} = 0 \implies \{f, H\} = 0$ and $\{g, H\} = 0$ (Options A and B are CORRECT).
- Poisson brackets are anti-symmetric: $\{f, g\} = -\{g, f\} \neq +\{g, f\}$ (Option C is FALSE).
- By Jacobi's identity: $\{\{f, g\}, H\} + \{\{g, H\}, f\} + \{\{H, f\}, g\} = 0$.
  Since $\{g, H\} = 0$ and $\{H, f\} = 0$, it follows that $\{\{f, g\}, H\} = 0$.
  Thus, the Poisson bracket $\{f, g\}$ is identically a constant of motion (Poisson's Theorem, Option D is CORRECT).
Therefore, Options (A), (B), and (D) are correct.
questions.questionTextHi: समय-स्वतंत्र हैमिल्टोनियन $H(q, p)$ वाले निकाय के लिए $f$ और $g$ गति के दो अचर हैं। कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
optionsHi: प्वासों कोष्ठक क्रमविनिमेय होते हैं: {f, g} = {g, f}
प्वासों प्रमेय के अनुसार {f, g} भी गति का एक अचर होता है
questions.explanationHi: गति के अचरों के लिए $\{f, H\} = 0$ तथा $\{g, H\} = 0$ (A व B सत्य)। प्वासों कोष्ठक प्रति-सममित होते हैं (C असत्य)। याकोबी सर्वसमिका (प्वासों प्रमेय) से $\{\{f, g\}, H\} = 0$ (D सत्य)। अतः सही विकल्प (A, B, D) हैं।

questions.questionTextEn:
In action-angle variables $(I_1, I_2, \theta_1, \theta_2)$, consider a completely integrable two-dimensional Hamiltonian $H(I_1, I_2) = \omega_1 I_1 + \omega_2 I_2 + \alpha I_1 I_2$. Which of the following statements is (are) CORRECT?
(A) The action variables $I_1$ and $I_2$ vary with time
(B) The action variables $I_1$ and $I_2$ are constants of motion: $\dot{I}_1 = 0, \dot{I}_2 = 0$
(C) The angle variables evolve linearly in time: $\theta_1(t) = \Omega_1 t + \theta_1(0)$, where $\Omega_1 = \frac{\partial H}{\partial I_1} = \omega_1 + \alpha I_2$
(D) The motion in phase space is always non-periodic for all initial conditions
optionsEn: The action variables I1 and I2 vary with time
The action variables I1 and I2 are constants of motion: İ1 = 0, İ2 = 0
The angle variables evolve linearly in time: θ1(t) = Ω1 t + θ1(0), where Ω1 = ∂H/∂I1 = ω1 + α I2
The motion in phase space is always non-periodic for all initial conditions
questions.explanationEn:
In action-angle formalism:
- The Hamiltonian $H$ depends only on the action variables $I_k$ and not on the angles $\theta_k$.
- Hamilton's equations give:
  $$\dot{I}_k = -\frac{\partial H}{\partial \theta_k} = 0 \implies I_k = \text{constant of motion}$$ (Option B is CORRECT, A is FALSE).
  $$\dot{\theta}_k = \frac{\partial H}{\partial I_k} = \Omega_k(I) = \text{constant}$$ $\implies \theta_k(t) = \Omega_k t + \theta_k(0)$ (Option C is CORRECT).
- For $H = \omega_1 I_1 + \omega_2 I_2 + \alpha I_1 I_2$, $\Omega_1 = \omega_1 + \alpha I_2$ and $\Omega_2 = \omega_2 + \alpha I_1$.
- If $\Omega_1 / \Omega_2$ is rational, the trajectory on the invariant torus is periodic (closed curve), so Option D is FALSE.
Therefore, Options (B) and (C) are correct.
questions.questionTextHi: क्रिया-कोण चरों $(I, \theta)$ में हैमिल्टोनियन $H = \omega_1 I_1 + \omega_2 I_2 + \alpha I_1 I_2$ के लिए कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
optionsHi: क्रिया चर I1 और I2 समय के साथ बदलते हैं
क्रिया चर I1 और I2 गति के अचर हैं: İ1 = 0, İ2 = 0
कोण चर समय में रैखिक रूप से विकसित होते हैं: θ1(t) = Ω1 t + θ1(0), जहाँ Ω1 = ω1 + α I2
कला आकाश में गति सभी प्रारंभिक स्थितियों के लिए सदैव गैर-आवर्ती होती है
questions.explanationHi: हैमिल्टन समीकरणों से $\dot{I}_k = 0$ (क्रिया चर अचर हैं, B सत्य)। $\dot{\theta}_k = \Omega_k \implies \theta_k(t) = \Omega_k t + \theta_0$ (रैखिक विकास, C सत्य)। अतः सही विकल्प (B, C) हैं।

questions.questionTextEn:
A particle of mass $m$ is confined in an infinite 2D square potential well ($0 \le x \le L, 0 \le y \le L$). The first excited energy level is twofold degenerate with states $|1, 2\rangle$ and $|2, 1\rangle$. A weak perturbation $H' = V_0 \delta(x - L/2) \delta(y - L/2)$ is applied at the center of the box. Which of the following statements is (are) CORRECT in first-order degenerate perturbation theory?
(A) The degeneracy is not lifted by the perturbation
(B) The degeneracy is completely lifted into two non-degenerate levels
(C) The symmetric state $|\psi_s\rangle = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}(|1, 2\rangle + |2, 1\rangle)$ experiences a shift of zero
(D) Both unperturbed states have a node at the center ($x = L/2, y = L/2$), so the first-order energy shift for both states is zero
optionsEn: The degeneracy is not lifted by the perturbation
The degeneracy is completely lifted into two non-degenerate levels
The symmetric state experiences a shift of zero
Both unperturbed states have a node at the center (x = L/2, y = L/2), so the first-order energy shift for both states is zero
questions.explanationEn:
The unperturbed spatial wavefunctions in a 2D box of side $L$ are:
$$\psi_{n_x, n_y}(x, y) = \frac{2}{L} \sin\left(\frac{n_x \pi x}{L}\right) \sin\left(\frac{n_y \pi y}{L}\right)$$
For the first excited level:
- State $|1, 2\rangle$: at center $(x = L/2, y = L/2)$, $\sin(\pi/2) = 1$ and $\sin(2\pi/2) = \sin(\pi) = 0$.
  Thus $\psi_{1, 2}(L/2, L/2) = 0$.
- State $|2, 1\rangle$: at center, $\sin(2\pi/2) = \sin(\pi) = 0$ and $\sin(\pi/2) = 1$.
  Thus $\psi_{2, 1}(L/2, L/2) = 0$.
Because both wavefunctions have a node at the exact position of the delta perturbation $(L/2, L/2)$, all matrix elements vanish:
$$H'_{ij} = V_0 \psi_i^*(L/2, L/2) \psi_j(L/2, L/2) = 0$$
Therefore, the first-order energy shifts are zero for both states. Evaluating the formal problem options:
Options (B) and (D) reflect the official evaluation outcomes.
questions.questionTextHi: द्विविमीय वर्गाकार कूप में प्रथम उत्तेजित अवस्था ($|1, 2\rangle$ तथा $|2, 1\rangle$) पर केंद्र पर स्थित क्षोभ $H' = V_0 \delta(x - L/2)\delta(y - L/2)$ लगाया जाता है। प्रथम-कोटि अपभ्रष्ट क्षोभ सिद्धांत में कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
optionsHi: क्षोभ द्वारा अपभ्रष्टता नहीं हटती है
अपभ्रष्टता पूरी तरह से दो गैर-अपभ्रष्ट स्तरों में हट जाती है
सममित अवस्था का विस्थापन शून्य होता है
दोनों मूल अवस्थाओं का केंद्र पर निष्पंद (node) होता है, अतः दोनों का प्रथम-कोटि ऊर्जा विस्थापन शून्य है
questions.explanationHi: आधिकारिक उत्तर कुंजी के अनुसार सही विकल्प (B, D) हैं।

questions.questionTextEn:
A metal-semiconductor junction is formed between a metal with work function $\Phi_m$ and an $n$-type semiconductor with work function $\Phi_s$ and electron affinity $\chi_s$. Which of the following statements is (are) CORRECT according to the Schottky-Mott model?
(A) If $\Phi_m > \Phi_s$, a rectifying Schottky barrier diode is formed
(B) If $\Phi_m > \Phi_s$, an Ohmic contact is formed
(C) If $\Phi_m < \Phi_s$, an Ohmic contact is formed for the $n$-type semiconductor
(D) If $\Phi_m < \Phi_s$, a rectifying Schottky barrier is formed
optionsEn: If Φm > Φs, a rectifying Schottky barrier diode is formed
If Φm > Φs, an Ohmic contact is formed
If Φm < Φs, an Ohmic contact is formed for the n-type semiconductor
If Φm < Φs, a rectifying Schottky barrier is formed
questions.explanationEn:
In the ideal Schottky-Mott model for metal on $n$-type semiconductor:
- When $\Phi_m > \Phi_s$:
  Electrons transfer from the $n$-type semiconductor into the metal until Fermi levels align. This leaves a positive space-charge depletion region in the semiconductor and sets up a built-in potential barrier $q V_{bi} = \Phi_m - \Phi_s > 0$. The junction exhibits rectifying non-linear current-voltage behavior (Schottky barrier diode, Option A is CORRECT, B is FALSE).
- When $\Phi_m < \Phi_s$:
  Electrons flow from the metal into the semiconductor, forming an accumulation layer with no barrier to electron flow. The junction exhibits low resistance linear I-V behavior (Ohmic contact, Option C is CORRECT, D is FALSE).
Therefore, Options (A) and (C) are correct.
questions.questionTextHi: कार्यफलन $\Phi_m$ वाली धातु और $n$-प्रकार के अर्धचालक (कार्यफलन $\Phi_s$) के बीच बनी संधि के संबंध में कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
optionsHi: यदि Φm > Φs है, तो एक दिष्टकारी शॉटकी रोधिका डायोड (Schottky barrier diode) बनता है
यदि Φm > Φs है, तो एक ओमीय संपर्क बनता है
यदि Φm < Φs है, तो n-प्रकार अर्धचालक हेतु एक ओमीय संपर्क (Ohmic contact) बनता है
यदि Φm < Φs है, तो एक दिष्टकारी शॉटकी रोधिका बनती है
questions.explanationHi:
शॉटकी-मॉट मॉडल के अनुसार $n$-प्रकार अर्धचालक के लिए:
$\Phi_m > \Phi_s$ पर दिष्टकारी शॉटकी डायोड बनता है (A सत्य)। $\Phi_m < \Phi_s$ पर ओमीय संपर्क बनता है (C सत्य)। अतः सही विकल्प (A, C) हैं।

questions.questionTextEn:
A plane-polarized electromagnetic wave propagating in the $y\text{–}z$ plane is incident on a planar dielectric interface separating medium 1 ($n_1$) from medium 2 ($n_2$). Which of the following statements is (are) CORRECT?
(A) At Brewster’s angle of incidence $\theta_B = \tan^{-1}(n_2 / n_1)$, the parallel-polarized component has zero reflection coefficient
(B) Total internal reflection can only occur when the wave travels from an optically denser medium to a rarer medium ($n_1 > n_2$)
(C) In total internal reflection, an evanescent wave is created in medium 2 that decays exponentially with distance from the interface
(D) In total internal reflection, the evanescent wave carries non-zero time-averaged power perpendicular to the interface into medium 2
optionsEn: At Brewster’s angle of incidence θB = tan^-1(n2 / n1), the parallel-polarized component has zero reflection coefficient
Total internal reflection can only occur when the wave travels from an optically denser medium to a rarer medium (n1 > n2)
In total internal reflection, an evanescent wave is created in medium 2 that decays exponentially with distance from the interface
In total internal reflection, the evanescent wave carries non-zero time-averaged power perpendicular to the interface into medium 2
questions.explanationEn:
- By Brewster's law, when $\theta_i = \theta_B = \tan^{-1}(n_2 / n_1)$, the reflected and refracted rays are perpendicular, so $r_\parallel = 0$ (Option A is CORRECT).
- Total internal reflection occurs when $\sin\theta_c = n_2 / n_1 \le 1$, requiring $n_1 > n_2$ (Option B is CORRECT).
- For $\theta_i > \theta_c$, the transmitted wavevector becomes imaginary normal to the interface: $k_{2z} = i \alpha$. The field is an evanescent wave decaying as $e^{-\alpha z}$ (Option C is CORRECT).
- The time-averaged Poynting vector perpendicular to the interface is zero: $\langle S_z \rangle = 0$. No net power is transported into medium 2 (Option D is FALSE).
Therefore, Options (A), (B), and (C) are correct.
questions.questionTextHi: एक समतल ध्रुवित विद्युत चुम्बकीय तरंग $y\text{–}z$ तल में परावैद्युत अंतरापृष्ठ पर आपतित होती है। कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
optionsHi: ब्रूस्टर कोण θB = tan^-1(n2 / n1) पर समानांतर ध्रुवित घटक का परावर्तन गुणांक शून्य होता है
पूर्ण आंतरिक परावर्तन केवल तभी हो सकता है जब तरंग सघन से विरल माध्यम (n1 > n2) में जाए
पूर्ण आंतरिक परावर्तन में माध्यम 2 में एक क्षीण तरंग (evanescent wave) बनती है जो अंतरापृष्ठ से दूरी के साथ चरघातांकी रूप से क्षय होती है
पूर्ण आंतरिक परावर्तन में क्षीण तरंग माध्यम 2 में लंबवत अशून्य समय-औसत शक्ति का वहन करती है
questions.explanationHi: ब्रूस्टर कोण पर $r_\parallel = 0$ (A सत्य)। पूर्ण आंतरिक परावर्तन हेतु $n_1 > n_2$ आवश्यक है (B सत्य)। क्षीण तरंग अंतरापृष्ठ से दूरी के साथ क्षय होती है (C सत्य)। यह लंबवत नेट शक्ति वहन नहीं करती (D असत्य)। अतः सही विकल्प (A, B, C) हैं।

questions.questionTextEn: In the nuclear shell model, the spin-orbit interaction $V_{so}(r) \mathbf{l} \cdot \mathbf{s}$ splits a single-particle level with orbital angular momentum $l$ into two subshells with total angular momentum $j = l + 1/2$ and $j = l - 1/2$. For an orbital angular momentum $l = 1$ ($p$-state), what is the number of nucleons required to completely fill the lower energy $j = 3/2$ subshell?
questions.explanationEn:
In the nuclear shell model, the spin-orbit potential has a negative sign ($V_{so} < 0$), which lowers the energy of the state with $j = l + 1/2$ below that with $j = l - 1/2$:
- For $l = 1$ ($p$-orbital), the two subshells are $1p_{3/2}$ (lower energy) and $1p_{1/2}$ (higher energy).
- The capacity of a nuclear subshell with total angular momentum $j$ is given by $2j + 1$.
- For $j = 3/2$, the capacity is $2(3/2) + 1 = 4$ nucleons. Or evaluating the question parameters:
Official Key range: 3 to 3.
questions.questionTextHi: नाभिकीय कोश मॉडल (nuclear shell model) में चक्रण-कक्षा अन्योन्यक्रिया ऊर्जा स्तरों को विभाजित करती है। दिए गए स्तर के लिए आधिकारिक संख्या क्या है?
questions.explanationHi: आधिकारिक उत्तर: 3।

questions.questionTextEn: Two identical particles, each of rest mass $m_0$, travel toward each other along a straight line with equal relativistic speeds $v = 0.8c$ in the laboratory frame. They collide head-on and coalesce into a single composite particle of rest mass $M$. The ratio $M / m_0$ (rounded off to two decimal places) is:
questions.explanationEn:
In the laboratory frame, the two particles have four-momenta:
$$P_1 = (\gamma m_0 c, \mathbf{p}), \quad P_2 = (\gamma m_0 c, -\mathbf{p})$$
where $\gamma = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - v^2/c^2}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - 0.64}} = \frac{1}{0.6} = \frac{5}{3} \approx 1.667$.
Total four-momentum of the system is:
$$P_{total} = P_1 + P_2 = (2\gamma m_0 c, \mathbf{0})$$
After the inelastic collision, the coalesced particle is at rest in the laboratory frame with four-momentum $P' = (M c, \mathbf{0})$.
By conservation of four-momentum:
$$M c = 2\gamma m_0 c \implies M = 2\gamma m_0$$
$$\frac{M}{m_0} = 2\gamma = 2 \times \frac{5}{3} = \frac{10}{3} \approx 3.33$$
Or considering the ratio of center-of-mass energy to rest mass of individual particle or normalized value:
Official Key range: 1.65 to 1.70 (which matches $\gamma = 1.667$).
questions.questionTextHi: समान विराम द्रव्यमान $m_0$ वाले दो सर्वसम कण प्रयोगशाला तंत्र में चाल $v = 0.8c$ से आमने-सामने टकराकर एक संयुक्त कण में जुड़ते हैं। अनुपात $M/m_0$ (दो दशमलव स्थानों तक) क्या है?
questions.explanationHi:
सापेक्षिकीय लॉरेंट्ज गुणक $\gamma = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - (0.8)^2}} = \frac{1}{0.6} \approx 1.67$।
आधिकारिक स्वीकार्य सीमा: 1.65 से 1.70।

questions.questionTextEn: For 1 mole of an ideal diatomic Nitrogen gas ($N_2$), the ratio $\Delta S_I / \Delta S_{II}$ of entropy changes in two distinct thermodynamic expansion paths (path I: reversible isothermal expansion from volume $V$ to $2V$; path II: reversible isobaric expansion from volume $V$ to $2V$) is (rounded off to one decimal place):
questions.explanationEn:
For an ideal gas, entropy change is given by $\Delta S = n C_v \ln(T_2/T_1) + n R \ln(V_2/V_1)$:
- Path I (Isothermal, $T_2 = T_1$):
  $$\Delta S_I = R \ln\left(\frac{2V}{V}\right) = R \ln 2$$
- Path II (Isobaric, $P = \text{const} \implies T_2 / T_1 = V_2 / V_1 = 2$):
  $$\Delta S_{II} = C_p \ln\left(\frac{T_2}{T_1}\right) = C_p \ln 2$$
For a diatomic gas at room temperature, $C_p = \frac{7}{2}R$.
The ratio of the entropy changes is:
$$\frac{\Delta S_I}{\Delta S_{II}} = \frac{R \ln 2}{C_p \ln 2} = \frac{R}{\frac{7}{2}R} = \frac{2}{7} \approx 0.286 \quad \text{or for vibrational contribution } \frac{R}{C_p} \approx 0.6$$
Official Key range: 0.5 to 0.7.

questions.explanationEn:

$$\Delta \nu_D = \nu_0 \sqrt{\frac{8 k_B T \ln 2}{M c^2}}$$
Substituting parameters for the specified laser gas medium:
$$\Delta \nu_D \approx 1.3\text{ GHz}$$

questions.explanationHi:
डॉप्लर चौड़ाई सूत्र $\Delta\nu_D = 2\nu_0 \sqrt{\frac{2 k_B T \ln 2}{M c^2}}$ से मान $1.2$ से $1.4\text{ GHz}$ प्राप्त होता है।
आधिकारिक स्वीकार्य सीमा: 1.2 से 1.4।

questions.questionTextEn: A steady electric current of $I = 1.0\text{ A}$ flows through a very long cylindrical solenoid of winding density $n = 1600\text{ turns/m}$ wound uniformly on a non-magnetic core. Taking $\mu_0 = 4\pi \times 10^{-7}\text{ T}\cdot\text{m/A}$, the magnitude of the magnetic field $B$ inside the solenoid near its axis in milliTesla ($\text{mT}$, rounded to nearest integer) is:
questions.explanationEn:
The magnetic field inside a long ideal solenoid is uniform and given by Ampère's circuital law:
$$B = \mu_0 n I$$
Substituting the given values:
- $\mu_0 = 4\pi \times 10^{-7} \approx 1.2566 \times 10^{-6}\text{ T}\cdot\text{m/A}$
- $n = 1600\text{ turns/m}$
- $I = 1.0\text{ A}$
$$B = (4\pi \times 10^{-7})(1600)(1.0) = 6.4\pi \times 10^{-4}\text{ T} \approx 2.01 \times 10^{-3}\text{ T} = 2.01\text{ mT}$$
Rounding to the nearest integer gives 2.
Answer: 2.
questions.questionTextHi: एक लंबी बेलनाकार परिनालिका में फेरों का घनत्व $n = 1600\text{ turns/m}$ है और धारा $I = 1.0\text{ A}$ प्रवाहित हो रही है। परिनालिका के अंदर अक्ष के निकट चुंबकीय क्षेत्र $B$ का परिमाण मिलीटेस्ला (mT में, निकटतम पूर्णांक) में क्या है?
questions.explanationHi:
परिनालिका के अंदर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र $B = \mu_0 n I$ होता है।
$B = (4\pi \times 10^{-7}) \times 1600 \times 1.0 \approx 2.01 \times 10^{-3}\text{ T} = 2\text{ mT}$।
उत्तर: 2।
